name: Robert Brewton House

dates.altered: The survey's data form: 'Side piazza removed (date unknown)'; the survey's photograph caption dates the entry's transom, jambs and architrave 'ca. 1800'.
dates.note: The HABS data form prints 1730 and the SC register 'built in 1730'; the Charleston Museum's collection record says 'sometime between 1721 and 1740'. Recorded as the survey and the register state it.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026 from the WP-11.1 research pass; a new exemplar on charleston-single-house. The survey's data form and the state register agree on 1730 and on 'earliest', which is what the type's origin is argued from; the survey records the side piazza REMOVED, so the house that proves the diagram no longer shows the piazza the node's prose calls its famous move.
